name: liminal apes
summary:
Liminal Apes feels like a dream you had after playing Gorilla Tag and watching too many Backrooms videos at 3 a.m.

You recognize the movement. You recognize the spaces. But everything is off just enough to make your stomach drop.

You’re not just running from monsters.
You’re wandering through the places between places—
where apes were never meant to be,
and now they’re the only things that are.
